# libyuv Source

Source mirror: https://github.com/lemenkov/libyuv

Pinned revision: `1ddb18fb6b6cc91f852648a6e64d2dee31b11a80`.

Original project: https://chromium.googlesource.com/libyuv/libyuv/

The `source/` and `include/` directories are unmodified upstream files. License, patent grant, and authors are included in `LICENSE`, `PATENTS`, and `AUTHORS`. JPEG support and architecture-specific kernels outside x64 are excluded from this application's build; SIMD dispatch for supported x64 CPU features is retained.
